$comment: Minimum control count per surface, the highest count a live run has ever enumerated there. A run that enumerates fewer controls on a surface than the number here fails the gate: coverage is proven over enumerated, so a surface rendering less than it used to would otherwise shrink the denominator and hold the percentage up while the app degrades. A floor key this run never swept fails too. Raising or lowering a floor is a separate, deliberate commit made with scripts/update-chat-coverage-floors.mjs against a recorded ledger, never by the run that checks them.
